events.title: Duong Tu Minh was married to the princess
events.description: Duong Tu Minh, leader of Phu Luong Prefecture (including present-day Thai Nguyen), made great contributions to securing the northern border. He was married to Princess Dien Binh by King Ly Nhan Tong, becoming a consort of the Ly Dynasty and a symbol of national unity.

events.title: Thai Nguyen Uprising
events.description: Doi Can (Trinh Van Can) and Luong Ngoc Quyen led soldiers and political prisoners to rise up, seize the barracks, break open the Thai Nguyen prison, and control the provincial capital for 7 days. This was the largest armed uprising in Tonkin during World War I.

events.title: Establishment of the 2nd National Salvation Army Platoon
events.description: In Khuon Manh forest, the 2nd National Salvation Army Platoon was established, marking the development of the revolutionary armed forces after the Bac Son Uprising, becoming the core of guerrilla warfare in the Vo Nhai - Thai Nguyen region.

events.title: Merger of the Vietnam Propaganda Liberation Army and the National Salvation Army
events.description: At the Quang village communal house, the merger ceremony of the Vietnam Propaganda Liberation Army and the National Salvation Army into the Vietnam Liberation Army took place. Comrade Vo Nguyen Giap was appointed Commander.

events.title: Liberation of Thai Nguyen Town
events.description: The Liberation Army detachment commanded by Comrade Vo Nguyen Giap advanced from Tan Trao to surround and attack the Japanese forces in Thai Nguyen Town. On the afternoon of the same day, the Uprising Committee announced the abolition of the puppet government and established the Provisional Revolutionary People's Committee.

events.title: Uncle Ho arrives at ATK Dinh Hoa
events.description: President Ho Chi Minh, along with the Party Central Committee agencies and the Government, moved to ATK (Safe Zone) Dinh Hoa to lead the long-term resistance war. Khau Ty Hill was his first residence and workplace in the ATK.

events.title: The first General promotion ceremony
events.description: At Na Lom Hill (by the Khuon Tat stream), President Ho Chi Minh presided over the ceremony to promote Commander-in-Chief Vo Nguyen Giap to the rank of General. He was the first General of the Vietnam People's Army.

events.title: Decision to launch the Dien Bien Phu Campaign
events.description: At Tin Keo hut, the Party Central Committee Politburo, presided over by President Ho Chi Minh, met and approved the 1953-1954 Winter-Spring combat plan, deciding to launch the historic Dien Bien Phu Campaign.

events.title: The first batch of pig iron from the Thai Nguyen Iron and Steel Complex
events.description: Blast Furnace No. 1 of the Thai Nguyen Iron and Steel Industrial Zone produced its first batch of pig iron. This event marked the birth of Vietnam's ferrous metallurgy industry, turning Thai Nguyen into the 'Steel City'.

events.title: Shooting down B-52 bombers
events.description: During the Dien Bien Phu in the Air campaign, Self-Defense Company 98 of the Thai Nguyen Iron and Steel Complex and the 256th Anti-Aircraft Regiment coordinated their fight, shooting down two US B-52 bombers as they bombed to destroy the industrial zone.

events.title: Re-establishment of Thai Nguyen Province
events.description: The 9th National Assembly passed the Resolution to split Bac Thai Province (merged since 1965) back into two provinces, Thai Nguyen and Bac Kan. Thai Nguyen Province officially operated under the new administrative unit from 01/01/1997.
